answer: Nacre-probation: a fresh identity is a bare grain, and the network coats it with one pearl layer only in epochs where it answers honestly and countersigns peers it did not choose; each layer is sealed under the epoch's beacon cipher hash, so layers cannot be backdated, gifted, or bought. Grading seats open only at layer four. Sybil farms can still plant an orchard of bare grains, but the orchard yields nothing, because the sole path to standing is four independent epochs of verifiable work per clone — the same cost as simply being honest.
